title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Review Service Standard and Consequences of Approval or Rejection
content:
## Clause

Once a Dangerous Goods Acceptance file is under review, the line decides it within the category's review service standard, which is expressed in hours. The review ends in one of two ways: the goods are accepted for the booking's sailing (approval) or refused (rejection).

## Basis of the decision

The former test, under which the line approved when the signed declaration fitted the category's admission conditions while the booking mix and the sailing allotment still held, and rejected in every other case, is **no longer in force**. It is replaced by the current basis for review decisions of this product.

## What each outcome brings with it

| Outcome | What the shipper is told | Charge | Date recorded on the acceptance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rejection | the reason for the refusal | nothing is charged for a rejection | — |
| Approval | — | the administration fee of the category | the approval date |

## Points of judgement

**Is a rejected shipper billed for the review?** No. A rejection never carries a charge.

**Which date does an approval set?** The approval date on the acceptance record; the administration fee is charged with that same approval.

superseded_clauses: It approves when the signed declaration fits the category under dg_application_eligibility and the booking mix and sailing allotment still hold, and it rejects otherwise
